aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.affinity: At an arcane anvil, combine the ring with a spell scroll. Wearing the attuned ring raises that spell by one level.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.backpack: Press %s to open the worn backpack and reach its contents and upgrades.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.betrayer_: Base cooldown is 5 seconds. Cooldown reduction applies.
Your attacks deal extra damage to a target whose maximum mana exceeds its base value.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.concentra: Taking damage no longer interrupts long casts.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.crown: Wear in the helmet slot to attract nearby bees. The head accessory slot displays the crown as decoration.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.cursed_do: Its affinity raises %s and %s by one level each.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.expulsion: Base cooldown is 2 seconds. Cooldown reduction applies.
When another entity damages you, a gust pushes nearby enemies away.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.fish_find: Shows the time, moon phase, biome temperature, depth and weather forecast together.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.fishing_h: Equip in the fishing information slot to show its reading on the fishing display.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.frostward: Prevents freezing in powder snow and lets you walk on its surface.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.gas_mask: Wear on your head or in the head accessory slot to breathe in gas clouds. Lingering potions, dragon’s breath and potion blobs still affect you.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.goggles: Look at Create machinery to see its operating readings, including stress and tank contents where available.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.greater_c: When a summon lasts until its timer expires, its summoning spell skips the cooldown.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.invisibil: Reveals invisible creatures to the wearer.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.key: A key on your belt opens matching Supplementaries locks. Name the key at an anvil to set its password.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.lurker_co: Base cooldown is 15 seconds. Cooldown reduction applies.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.lurker_ri: While you are invisible, your attack deals 50% extra damage when the ring is ready.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.necronomi: Its affinity raises %s by two levels.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.pearls: Only the strongest pearl necklace in your inventory or necklace slot applies.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.pearls_ef: Increases swim speed and reduces the distance at which drowned target you. Tiers II and III also reduce the detection range of guardians.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.poisonwar: Continuously removes the Poison effect while worn.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.purifier: Prevents the Thirst status effect from drinking unsafe water. You still need to drink.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.quiver: Stores arrows for your bow. Use %s to select the ammunition.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.spyglass: Hold %s to look through the spyglass on your belt.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.terminal: Sneak and use it on a storage terminal to bind it. Press %s to open that storage while its chunk is loaded.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.terminal_: Normal range is 64 blocks. A powered beacon within 8 blocks of the terminal gives unlimited range in the dimension at tier I, and across dimensions at tier IV.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.thermal_r: Grants 3 thermal resistance against both heat and cold.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.visibilit: Removes Blindness and Darkness while worn.
aeroscapes_reimagine.accessory.wicked_bo: Each worn ring adds one bounce to spell projectiles that support ricochets.
